image_plan.purpose: Main ecommerce model image showing fit and full front view.
image_plan.prompt_en: Use the same model identity as Latina_Sunny_Ecom_02: one adult Latina female ecommerce fashion model, age 22-28, warm golden-brown tan skin, dark brown naturally wavy long hair, bright friendly smile, fresh everyday makeup, healthy balanced body shape, casual energetic posture, approachable and product-focused. She is wearing a black two-piece women's casual set: oversized short-sleeve button-up shirt with classic collar, loose fit, and matching black high-waist shorts in 100% cotton look. Front view, standing relaxed with one hand near pocket, shirt slightly tucked at the front to show the waistband, clean bright studio background, soft natural light, SHEIN-like fast fashion ecommerce photography, sharp clothing details, full outfit visible from head to mid-thigh, no text, no logo, no watermark.
image_plan.prompt_zh: 使用 Latina_Sunny_Ecom_02 固定模特身份。成年拉美女性电商模特，健康暖棕小麦色肤色，深棕自然波浪长发，清爽日常妆，亲和阳光。穿黑色两件套：宽松短袖翻领纽扣衬衫，搭配黑色高腰短裤，100% 棉质视觉。正面站姿，一只手靠近口袋，衬衫前摆轻微塞入展示腰线，明亮干净棚拍背景，柔和自然光，Shein 类快时尚电商摄影，服装细节清晰，无文字、无 logo、无水印。
image_plan.composition_notes: Vertical 4:5 or 3:4 crop, leave clean margin, product is primary focus.

image_plan.purpose: Back view showing shirt length, shoulder seam and shorts coverage.
image_plan.prompt_en: Same Latina_Sunny_Ecom_02 adult Latina ecommerce model identity, wearing the black cotton-look oversized short-sleeve button-up shirt and matching black high-waist shorts. Back view with the model turning her head slightly to the side, natural posture, arms relaxed, shirt untucked to show back length and loose drape, shorts hem visible, clean bright studio background, soft natural light, product-focused marketplace photography, sharp seams and fabric texture, no text, no logo, no watermark.
image_plan.prompt_zh: 同一位 Latina_Sunny_Ecom_02 模特，穿黑色棉质视觉宽松短袖翻领纽扣衬衫和黑色高腰短裤。背面视角，模特微微侧头，姿态自然，手臂放松，衬衫不塞入以展示后背长度和宽松垂坠，短裤下摆清晰可见，明亮干净棚拍，柔和自然光，商品展示优先，无文字、无 logo、无水印。
image_plan.composition_notes: Vertical crop, show from head to upper thigh, avoid hiding garment details with hair or bag.
